response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, long-tenured full-stack/systems engineer with roughly 15+ years of experience and strong craftsmanship credentials, but his background is overwhelmingly in general web/mobile/embedded software development rather than AI/ML or cloud strategy. There is minimal evidence of AI product building, cloud platform expertise, or strategic advisory experience at the director/principal level required for this role.
strengths: Extensive 15+ year engineering career across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure domains
Demonstrated thought leadership via talks, workshops, and open-source projects
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at current role
concerns: No advanced degree or formal AI/ML specialization (PhD/Master's in AI preferred)
Lack of demonstrated large-scale cloud platform strategy or architecture experience
No evidence of advising strategic customers/partners or director-level strategic influence

key_factors.factor: Limited AI/ML depth and product experience
No cloud strategy or platform-level architecture experience
Long, diverse engineering tenure with leadership and teaching involvement
